LESSON: SAFETY WHEN

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment 1.4 Plants By the end of the sub-strand, the learner  Learners to c
Topic 1.4.2: Safety when

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Safety when. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe safe ways of handling different plants
2. observe safety when handling different plants in the immediate environment
3. appreciate the need to handle plants responsibly to reduce health risks.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe safe ways of handling different plants
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to describe safe ways of handling different plants. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. observe safety when handling different plants in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe safety when handling different plants in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the need to handle plants responsibly to reduce health risks.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the need to handle plants responsibly to reduce health risks. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Safety when.
2. Explain Safety when to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Safety when.
4. Show that you can: describe safe ways of handling different plants
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Safety when. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Safety when important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. describe safe ways of handling different plants
2. observe safety when handling different plants in the immediate environment
3. appreciate the need to handle plants responsibly to reduce health risks.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
